ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone that last opened the app before typed bridges (SQLite, atlas rows at `a14.p9`), open Explore, then, once chronicles-data publishes contract v8, walk (Explore on) near a suspension bridge known only by its type and near a listed covered bridge. **Expect:** every `atlas_area` and landing row is derived again once (p10) with no stall or empty bars; the archive pmtiles read yields both under Bridges with their "?" pins, named within 60 m; the typed suspension bridge adds nothing to History while the covered bridge lights it (MA10).
